answer: The walnut register is checked at draw time, wander lists the eligible set, and sonnet seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 36 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 36 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 175 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
